text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Nov 19 - Chittagong - Sixteen vessels in port of which 6 containers, 1 ro/ro, 4 fertiliser, 4 general cargo import, 1 cement loader. 25 Vessels due by 26/11 of which 10 containers, 3 cement loaders, 6 general cargo import, 1 food grain, 1 cement, 4 other vessels.

BURMA, Nov 17 - Rangoon - Twenty-four vessels in port of which berthed, 2 general cargo, 3 other bulkers. 19 vessels anchored of which 6 tankers, 13 other bulkers. 23 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, 3-7 days berthing delay expected.

CHINA, Nov 16 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored, berthing delays grain 5 days, coal 2 days, iron ore 3 days, steel 1 day. Kaohsiung - Four vessels anchored. Delays grain/steel 1 day, iron/coal 3 days (csc berth), coal/scrap 1 day (public berth). Taichung - Five vessels anchored, delays grain 2-3 days, iron ore/coal/steel/others 1 day, no delays scrap. Nov 18 - Keelung - 28 In port, 14 containers, 2 tankers, 9 other bulkers, 3 general cargo. 8 Waiting at outer anchorage, 7 containers, 1 other bulker. Berthing delays containers 16 hours, other bulkers 2 days. Kaohsiung - 69 In port, 10 containers, 7 tankers, 1 grain, 2 other bulkers, 32 general cargo, 17 at buoys, none at outer anchorage, no delays.

INDIA, Nov 19 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 2-3 days, bulk vessels 9-10 days, general cargo 4-5 days. 8 Vessels loading at berth, 19 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage. 8 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 19 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 2 Vessels bunkering, 5 under repairs, 2 awaiting orders. Calcutta - Twenty-three vessels due of which 6 coal, 7 product tankers, 1 crude tanker, 7 contner vessels, 1 coke, 1 limestone. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 12 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 2 vessels bunkering. Cochin - Two vessels due, up to 1 days delay expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 2 in shipyard dry-dock.

Mormugao - One container vessel due, up to 1 days delay expected, 1 phosphoric acid due, up to 1 days delay expected, 9 ore vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 3 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at berth. 4 Waiting at anchorage to load, 1 bunkering. 4 Vessels under repair/dry-dock, 1 awaiting orders. Kandla - Ten vessels due, 6-7 days berthing delay expected. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 12 waiting at anchorage to load. 21 Tankers berthed. Mangalore - Fourteen vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. 6 Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 1 awaiting berth, 1 bunkering.

Madras - Thirty-one vessels due by 27/11 of which 8 containers, 2 fertiliser, 4 coal, 12 general cargo, 1 iron ore, 1 phosphoric acid, 1 molasses, 2 edible oil. Delays expected, coal/coke 5 days, fertiliser 4-5 days, scrap 5-6 days, containers, iron ore 1-2 days, others 2-3 days. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 14 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 19 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Jawaharlal Nehru - No vessels due, 15-20 days berthing delay expected, 1 vessel due (tanker/iron ore), up to 1 days delay expected. 2 Vessels discharging at berth (fertiliser/raw material), 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge (tankers/iron ore), 3 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (fertiliser/raw material).

Paradip - Six vessels due, 3 days delay expected. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load. Tuticorin - Three vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorageo discharge, 1 survey vessel. Visakhapatnam - Delays expected for vessels due, iron ore up to 1 day, pig iron 2-3 days, wire coils/steel plates 7-8 days, coking coal 10-12 days, general cargo 7-8 days, phosphoric acid, magnetite, containers up to 1 day, general cargo 3 days, timber logs 2-3 days. 6 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth.

MALAYSIA, Nov 20 - Port Kelang - North port - Container berths - 4 Vessels alongside, 3 waiting. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 6 waiting with waiting time of 4 days. Dry bulk terminal - 1 Vessel alongside, 3 waiting with waiting time of 8 days. Bulk terminal no. 25 closed for repairs until further notice. West port - 4 Conventional vessels alongside, 2 cement carriers alongside discharging, 1 wharf occupied by passenger vessel. 1 Wharf vacant, 3 days waiting time. Dredging operations at conventional berths at West port will be carried out from 20/11 to 19/2/97 in stages.
MAURITIUS, Nov 19 - Port Louis - Port labour working normally. Two container vessels, 1 general cargo vessel discharging/loading. No idle vessels. Dry-dock idle. 16 Vessels due by 26/11.

PAKISTAN, Nov 17 - Bin Qasim - Berthing delays currently very high due to three berths having been handed over to PNO containers for construction of a container terminal. This leaves 4 berths, of which 2 are reserved for wheat vessels only and 1 for liquid cargoes. Thus only 1 berth is available to accomodate all other vessels. It is difficult to predict delays in advance, but the following delays have been experienced recently, jute (import) 24 days, sugar (import) 40 days, wheat (import) 9 days, steel slabs (import) 17 days, fuel oil (import) 4 days. As of 17/11, 4 vessels are anchored awaitng berths of which 1 sugar (since Oct), 1 pig iron (since 28/10), 1 sugar (since 4/11) and 1 wheat (since 11/11).

Karachi, Nov 18 - Six vessels loading at berth (rice, chrome, containers). 4 Loading/discharging at berth (containers, general cargo). 9 Discharging at berth (jute, urea, sugar, scrap, general cargo, palm oil, gasoil). 11 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (containers, fertiliser, oil tanker, dap, hsd, general cargo). 7 Vessels due with 24 hours delay expected.

PHILIPPINES - Manila - South harbour - 13 Vessels discharging at berth, 4 discharging at anchorage. 3 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage to discharge. Average waiting times, vessels with draft less than 8.5 metres and loa less then 130 metres 1 day, vessels with draft greater than 9 metres and loa greater than 140 metres 1 day. Occasional rain.

SIERRA LEONE, Nov 18 - Freetown - No labour problems. No vessels loading/discharging at berth. 1 Bulk carrier at anchor under arrest. 7 Vessels due of which 2 aid cargo dischargers, 1 mill feed loader, 1 container/vehicle discharger, 2 container dischargers, 1 bitumen discharger. Draft alongside berth 30 ft. 6 Ins. No restrtions on loa/beam. Vessels must endeavour to be in/out of port before 19.00 hrs for security reasons.

SOUTH KOREA, Nov 19 - Inchon - Sixty-seven vessels in port (48 berthed, 19 anchored) of which berthed, 12 general cargo, 7 logs, 5 containers, 3 pig-iron, 3 cars, 2 steel plates, 2 ply-wood, 1 machinery, 1 granite, 1 ilmenite, 1 steel, 1 coke, 1 bananas, 1 rape seed meal, 1 talc, 1 coils, 1 corn, 1 rye, 1 timber, 1 steel billets, 1 wheat. Vessels anchored, 5 general cargo, 3 logs, 2 cars, 2 containers, 1 talc, 1 raw sugar, 1 salt, 1 pig-iron, 1 tapioca, 1 steel, 1 molasses, approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Busan - 165 Vessels in port (52 berthed, 113 anchored including 56 laid-up) of which berthed, 35 general cargo, 9 containers, 5 scrap, 3 coal. 57 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 2 days delay expected.

Pohang - Fourteen vessels in port (12 berthed, 2 anchored) of which berthed and discharging, 2 coke, 2 billets, 2 coils, 1 iron ore, 1 chrome, 1 structures, 1 scrap, 2 steel vessels loading. 2 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 1 days delay expected. Ulsan - Eighteen vessels in port (15 berthed, 3 anchored), of which discharging, 2 feed meal, 2 crude oil, 2 wood-chip, 1 steel pipes, 1 soda ash, 1 styrene monomer, 1 lead bullion, 1 propylene, 1 wheat. Vessels loading, 1 resin, 1 ammonium sulphate, 1 base oil. 3 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 2 days delay expected. Masan - Seven vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 1 steel scrap, 1 pig iron, 1 steel plate, 1 containers, 1 talcum powder. 2 Vessels loading of which 1 containers, 1 coaches, no berthing delays expecd.

SRI LANKA, Nov 19 - Colombo - Vessels due, bulk cement, 1 breakbulk, 3 container vessels. 3-5 Days delay expected for conventional vessels. 16 Vessels loading at berth of which 4 essential services, 12 containers. 27 Vessels discharging at berth of which 2 bagged sugar, 3 bagged rice, 4 general cargo, 1 bagged flour, 12 container vessels, 1 sugar/steel, 1 bulk mop, 2 bagged fertiliser, 1 bulk palm oil. 14 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 7 containers (discharging/loading), 7 general cargo, 3 vessels bunkering. 5 Vessels under repair/dry-dock, 4 awaiting orders. Shortage of stevedores continues. Galle - No vessels. Trincomalee - Two vessels discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth.
THAILAND, Nov 15 - Bangkok - Ninety-two vessels in port of which 6 containers, 1 tanker, 85 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 2 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
